description: Status line for people who move a task between Claude Code and Codex with ccx (macOS). Shows the model, how much of Claude's and Codex's current 5-hour window is used, and whether this conversation is linked to a Codex thread and has progress Codex hasn't picked up yet. Suggests /to-codex when Claude is above 90%. Claude's usage comes from Claude Code's own rate_limits when present; Codex's usage and the link state come from the local `ccx usage --json` and `ccx info --json` commands (2-second timeout each, no network, nothing written). Without ccx it shows the model and an install hint. Requires ccx: https://github.com/aaronwong1999/ccx
